summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for Shri Puri Jagannath Trust site. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed (health, auth login/logout/me, gallery public + admin CRUD, contact). Frontend: Home hero, footer, all 10 nav routes, Gallery page (tabs+grid+filter+lightbox+prev/next/escape), Contact form (submit + success toast), and full Admin flow (unauth redirect, login, upload appears in grid, logout) all verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses `secure=True, samesite=none` cookies which requires HTTPS; correct for prod preview URL but will break local http testing.

Seed logic uses http URLs stored in image_data field though PhotoIn validation requires data:image/ prefix. Public GET works but the mismatch means seeded photos couldn't be created through the admin API. Minor inconsistency.
JWT_SECRET falls back to 'change-me' if env missing - flag as HIGH for production; fine for preview.

CORS uses `os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',')` combined with allow_credentials=True. When '*' is used with credentials, browsers reject. In practice preview works because same-origin routing; still recommend explicit origin list.
seed_data_creation: None (16 photos already auto-seeded by backend on startup). Test created and deleted TEST_ prefixed photos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all 16 API cases (auth + gallery + contact). Frontend nav uses data-testids nav-* and gallery/admin pages have full data-testid coverage. Note: hero title is split across DOM nodes so a plain `text=Jai Śrī Jagannātha of Nīlācala.` locator returns 0 - use partial matches. Multiple pages like /jagannathastakam use custom typography (not h1/h2) - use body text checks instead. Console shows 401 errors for /api/auth/me on public pages which is expected (unauth check).
